'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Objective overwritten; Senate suite as Plead My Case. OCR uncertain titles noted.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Power Of The Senate|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
